result.topic_en: Euler explains how to determine the elasticity constant cc of a lamina experimentally by clamping it to a wall, hanging a weight I at its free end, measuring the small deflection, and integrating the resulting differential equation of the curve.
result.transcription:
464 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
longitudo laminae pro arbitrio ſumta, cuius pondus
experientia definitum ſumſimus $=K$, at vero $cc$
eam denotat quantitatem, qua elaſticitas noſtrae la-
minae determinatur, ita ſcilicet vt ſi alicubi fuerit
radius curuaturae $=r$, momentum elaſticitatis futu-
rum ſit $=\frac{Kcc}{r}$, vnde valorem huius quantitatis per
experimenta explorari oportet, id quod commodiſſi-
Tab. VII. me ſequenti modo praeſtari poterit. Infigatur ea
Fig. 3. lamina longitudinis $k$, cuius pondus exploratum fuit
$K$, termino ſuo $Aa$ muro ſeu parieti immobili, vt
ſit $AK=k$, eique in termino $K$ appendatur ali-
quod pondus $I$, quo terminus $K$ normaliter ad $AK$
ſollicitetur, et vsque in $k$ detorqueatur, ita tamen, vt
hoc ſpatium $Kk$ vehementer ſit exiguum reſpectu
totius longitudinis $AK$, atque facile patet, ſi per ex-
perimentum exploratum fuerit iſtud ſpatiolum $Kk$
quod ſit $=i$, ex eo ipſam quantitatem $cc$ deter-
minari poſſe. Hic ergo ſola vis ſeu pondus $I$ in
laminam noſtram agit, vnde ſi ponatur abſciſſa
$KX=x$ et applicata $XY=y$, momentum huius
vis in punctum $y$ eſt $=Ix$ cui aequale eſſe debet
momentum elaſticitatis in puncto $Y$, quod vti ante
vidimus eſt
$$=\frac{Kcc}{r}=Kcc\left(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}\right),$$
ſicque pro figura huius laminae habebitur iſta ae-
quatio,
$$Ix=Kcc\left(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}\right), \text{ vnde } \frac{Kcc}{I}\left(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}\right)=x,$$
quae bis complete integrata praebet
$$\frac{Kcc}{I}y=\tfrac{1}{6}x^3+\alpha x+\beta.$$
XX.

items.english: hence the value of this quantity must be explored by experiments, which can most conveniently be done in the following way.

items.quote:

items.english: and it is easily seen that, if this small space Kk, which is i, has been found by experiment, the quantity cc itself can be determined from it.
